# Lumishrooms
Lumishrooms grow alone, deep in the dark under a roof: look for them in the caves below the surface. Their caps give off a soft green glow, so the easiest way to spot one is to put out your light.
A lumishroom is also its own seed. Plant it on dirt or mycelium and water it: mushrooms grow only on water, and a watered, fully grown lumishroom spreads to the neighbouring tiles, roughly one new mushroom per watering. Left dry, it just waits.
A lumishroom ferments right in the cap. Eat a couple and you will feel it.
